name: Gunslinger Moon
source:
After a tragic incident that took the life of my beloved mother and separated me from my childhood friend, I was forced to survive alone in a dangerous world of cold guns and ruthless bandits.

As I struggle to survive, I try to fulfill the promise to my late mother, at the same time, I desperately want to find my missing childhood friend. But as I embark on this journey full of ups and downs, I discover there are many things that I do not know about myself yet—and even more things, that I still need to learn.
translation:
在一场悲惨事件夺走了我深爱的母亲的生命，并使我与我儿时的朋友分开后，我被迫在一个充满冷枪和无情强盗的危险世界中独自生存。

我一边挣扎着生存，一边努力履行对已故母亲的承诺，同时也迫切地想找到失踪的儿时好友。但当我踏上这段充满坎坷的旅程时，我发现自己还有很多不了解的地方，甚至还有更多我需要学习的地方。
